items.text: Mitch Clemmons is a plumbing contractor and business owner. He studied aerospace engineering technology at California State Polytechnic University, Pomona, and has operated his own plumbing company since 2002.

items.text: His campaign says he is running because Congress needs more people who have built businesses and fixed real-world problems. He names election integrity as his top priority and supports the Save America Act and requiring proof of citizenship to vote. On immigration, he says the federal government must secure the border and enforce existing laws, and he supports reforming legal immigration to prioritize high-skilled workers.
